name: Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Ningxia Baofeng Energy Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells chemical products in China and internationally. It operates through Olefin Products, Coking Products, Fine Chemical Products, and Headquarters and Other Product segments. The company offers polypropylene, coking benzene, methyl tert-butyl ether, polyethylene, refined methanol, industrial sulfur, fertilizer-grade ammonium sulfate, mixed naphthalene, and coal tar pitch.
